assertions.description: OfflineAudioContextOptions.length is optional: constructing without it succeeds and the length attribute reads null (an indefinite rendering context).
assertions.test: (() => { try { const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, sampleRate: 8000 }); return ctx.length === null; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: startRendering(chunkSize) returns only the requested chunk: on a 512-frame context, startRendering(128) resolves with a 128-frame AudioBuffer instead of the whole render.
assertions.test: (async () => { const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, sampleRate: 8000, length: 512 }); const osc = new OscillatorNode(ctx); osc.connect(ctx.destination); osc.start(); const chunk = await ctx.startRendering(128); return chunk.length === 128; })()

assertions.description: A requested chunk size is rounded up to a render quantum boundary: startRendering(100) on a fresh 512-frame context resolves with 128 frames (one default quantum), not 100.
assertions.test: (async () => { const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, sampleRate: 8000, length: 512 }); const osc = new OscillatorNode(ctx); osc.connect(ctx.destination); osc.start(); const chunk = await ctx.startRendering(100); return chunk.length === 128; })()

assertions.description: Successive chunk calls are legal, and the final chunk of a finite render is trimmed to exactly the remaining frames: a 320-frame context rendered as startRendering(256) then startRendering(256) yields 256 + 64 frames.
assertions.test: (async () => { const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, sampleRate: 8000, length: 320 }); const osc = new OscillatorNode(ctx); osc.connect(ctx.destination); osc.start(); const first = await ctx.startRendering(256); const second = await ctx.startRendering(256); return first.length === 256 && second.length === 64; })()

assertions.description: A chunkSize of 0 rejects with NotSupportedError ('The requested chunk size cannot be zero').
assertions.test: (() => { const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, sampleRate: 8000, length: 512 }); const osc = new OscillatorNode(ctx); osc.connect(ctx.destination); osc.start(); return ctx.startRendering(0).then(() => false, (e) => e.name === 'NotSupportedError'); })()

assertions.description: Once a finite context has rendered all its frames, a further startRendering call rejects with InvalidStateError.
assertions.test: (async () => { const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, sampleRate: 8000, length: 256 }); const osc = new OscillatorNode(ctx); osc.connect(ctx.destination); osc.start(); const all = await ctx.startRendering(); if (all.length !== 256) return false; try { await ctx.startRendering(128); return false; } catch (e) { return e.name === 'InvalidStateError'; } })()
